content: The results of the Welch's t-test on OSG data reveal that there are statistically significant differences in the distribution of replying comments' sentiment between conversations with positive and negative starting posts. A positive post tends to get significantly more positive replies. Similarly, a negative post tends to get significantly more negative replies (both with $p < 0.01$).
